start: Joined gym; the trainer put a YouTube link on 'Barbell squat' in the member's gym workout plan; plans synced

steps.action: Open the exercise page of 'Barbell squat'
user_sees: A row 'Watch your trainer' with 'A video from <trainer> on YouTube' (or 'A video from your gym on YouTube')
must_not: The row on an exercise with no video
Another gym's video

user_sees: YouTube (or the browser) opens the trainer's video
must_not: A link that is not an https YouTube link opened
The app closing

start: Today's workout of the day (WOD) from the gym has a video on an exercise (another source)

user_sees: 'Watch your trainer' for the WOD's video
must_not: The plan's older video shown over the newest one

start: An exercise the trainer typed by hand (no library key), matched by name

steps.action: Open the exercise page with the same name (any case or spacing)
must_not: No row because of a case or extra space difference
A row on a different exercise with a similar name

start: The trainer typed a link that is not YouTube (or over 300 letters, or http)

user_sees: No 'Watch your trainer' row; the page exactly as before
must_not: The bad link offered or opened

start: Phone offline or YouTube cannot open

user_sees: Notice 'Couldn’t open the video' with 'Check your internet, then try again.'
must_not: No word at all
A crash

start: Video shown; then the trainer removes it, then the member leaves the gym

steps.action: After the next plan sync, open the page
must_not: The removed video still offered

steps.action: Leave the gym, open the page
user_sees: No 'Watch your trainer' row (the saved videos are forgotten)
must_not: The old gym's video still offered

start: Trainer video on the exercise page

user_sees: The video opens in YouTube, outside MettleUp
must_not: Anything about the member sent with the link
A non-YouTube site opened
